provenance.purpose: Line-search confound control (Codex P2 on PR #985): the May 2026 breach run predates the Armijo->Hager-Zhang default flip that landed in the same commit (029f4fe) as the probe script, so the May line search is unrecorded and plausibly Armijo, while the 2026-09-12 rerun used the HZ default. This run pins line_search_method='armijo' on the same commit/seed/warm-start as the HZ rerun; everything else is byte-identical (the SU warmstart energy reproduces the HZ run's -0.22540003330846212 exactly).
provenance.verdict: Floor HOLDS under Armijo: E=-0.39113 vs floor -0.43752 (delta +4.64e-2). The run ended at step 22/30 by early termination on line-search rejection (alpha=0 means 'no improving step found' and the outer loop breaks; pess_optimize.py:402 -- NOT a certified convergence criterion). Both line searches clear the floor on current main; combined with the loose-CTM rerun (kagome_pess_multisite_phase_c3_loose_ctm_rerun.json) the May breach is attributed to pre-fix code under the loose protocol. Armijo's deeper-than-HZ energy (-0.3911 vs -0.3706, same 30-step budget) is an optimizer-budget effect within the physical band, not a discrepancy.
